definition: Lasting for a very short time.
examples: Fashions are ephemeral; classics endure.

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
examples: She is meticulous about citing every source.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.
examples: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.

definition: Make less severe, serious, or painful.
examples: Measures were taken to mitigate the effects of the flood.

definition: A typical example or pattern of something; a model.
examples: A new paradigm of remote work has emerged.

definition: Logical and consistent; forming a unified whole.
examples: Her essay was coherent and well-structured.

definition: Strong and healthy; vigorous; able to withstand adverse conditions.
examples: The system is robust enough for concurrent use.

definition: Implied though not directly expressed.
examples: There was an implicit threat in his tone.

definition: Examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
examples: The auditor scrutinized every transaction.

definition: Open to more than one interpretation; unclear.
examples: The clause is ambiguous and needs revision.

definition: Make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe.
examples: The NGO works to ease pain.

definition: Making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible.
examples: A quiet room is conducive to study.

definition: A subtle difference in or shade of meaning, expression, or sound.
examples: The translator captured every nuance of the poem.

definition: Weaken or damage gradually or insidiously.
examples: His constant delays undermined the team's morale.

definition: Spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people.
examples: Pervasive misinformation is hard to combat.

definition: Look at thoughtfully for a long time; think deeply about.
examples: She contemplated the view from the cliff.

definition: Make known; reveal.
examples: The company disclosed its quarterly earnings.

definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
examples: Children are often remarkably resilient.

definition: Seeming reasonable or probable.
examples: His excuse sounded plausible.

definition: Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
examples: We received a substantial grant.
